messages.subject: facet_grid and geom_crossbar
parts:
dear Hadley,

I am very pleased for your last ggplot2 version and in fact this
package has completely superseded my previously preferred lattice.

However, I am still unable to replicate some features and need your
help for the following case, where I find difficulty with facet_grid()
and geom_crossbar():

plotting some observations (file obs.txt) with

qplot(data=obs, y=reorder(cv,pfce), x=pfce)+ facet_grid(tirev ~ . ,
scales='free_y', space='free') +opts(strip.text.y
=theme_text(angle=0))

gives the expected results, though I had to order previously the
variable tirev in order of decreasing pfce variable (not increasing,
as I supposed, maybe because of the default table order in facet_grid)

I tried to plot interval estimates for cv means (file fit.txt) with
the same choice of x and y variables, but it did nit work, so I tried
several other arrangements ending with the following:

ggplot(data=pfcedf, x=reorder(cv,fit), y=fit) +
geom_crossbar(aes(x=reorder(cv,fit), y=fit, min=lower, max=upper))
+coord_flip() + facet_grid(tirev ~ . , scales='free', space='free')

which does not give the cv subsets pertaining to the levels of the
variable tirev (panels)

Surely I have missed something, but dont' know what

Best regards
Filippo

I'm planning on making this easier to control in a future version, but
it will be some time away.

> I tried to plot interval estimates for cv means (file fit.txt) with
> the same choice of x and y variables, but it did nit work, so I tried
> several other arrangements ending with the following:
>
> ggplot(data=pfcedf, x=reorder(cv,fit), y=fit) +
> geom_crossbar(aes(x=reorder(cv,fit), y=fit, min=lower, max=upper))
> +coord_flip() + facet_grid(tirev ~ . , scales='free', space='free')
>
> which does not give the cv subsets pertaining to the levels of the
> variable tirev (panels)
>
> Surely I have missed something, but dont' know what

You'll notice the following works:

ggplot(data=pfcedf) +
geom_crossbar(aes(x=reorder(cv,fit), y=fit, ymin=lower, ymax=upper)) +
facet_grid(. ~ tirev, scales='free', space='free')

But it doesn't work with coord_flip() because facet_grid(scales =
"free") only works with Cartesian coordinates systems, because I
couldn't figure out how to get it to work in general. It's tricky
because it really needs to alter the facetting specification as well,
but there's no way to do that in the current code. Again, it's
something I want to think about, but unfortunately, there's not much
hope of progress in the short term.

Hadley
